beaches.name: Halikiada (Chalikiada), Agistri
beaches.summary: Nude and clothed bathers mix across this pebble cove southeast of Skala. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 1998 to 2022, with about half of bathers nude on busy days and more off-season; a local tourism site and 2025 press also describe it as the island's naturist beach. Reports from 2019 note intrusive photography by clothed day-trippers; wild camping is common.

beaches.name: Dragonera, Agistri
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported at the two ends of this otherwise swimwear beach. A naturist directory carries visitor reports from 2016 and 2019, while stating that nude sunbathing and wild camping are officially not tolerated there; no newer report is documented.
